snippet.title: Kill Your Friends // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4681250/Kill_Your_Friends

A chaotic 2–4 player PvP shooter where the game changes every round. New modes, weapons, and conditions force you to adapt before your friends do.

👥 Players: Online PvP
🛠️ Developer: Not Applicable
📚 Publisher: Not Applicable
📅 Release Date: Oct 8, 2026
🎯 Genre: Action, Casual, Indie

This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content
